observations.title: Purace volcano (Colombia)
observations.description: The Washington Volcanic Ash Advisory Center (VAAC) reported that during 8-14 October daily ash plumes from Puracé rose to 5.1-6.1 km (17,000-20,000 ft) a.s.l., or as high as 1.4 km above the summit, and drifted NW, WNW, and SW based on webcam images, satellite images, weather models, and Volcano Observatory Notices to Aviation issued by the Servicio Geológico Colombiano (SGC). Emissions on 13 October were considered likely, but were not detected due to weather conditions. The Alert Level remained at Yellow (the second lowest level on a four-color scale). Source: Washington Volcanic Ash Advisory Center (VAAC)
